description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductOptionValueDao interface, providing database access methods for ProductOptionValue entities within the shopizer project. It includes methods for listing, retrieving by ID or name, and retrieving by code, all scoped to a specific merchant store and language.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: Implements data access methods for ProductOptionValue entities, extending generic DAO functionality and providing custom queries for listing and retrieving option values based on store, name, code, and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all ProductOptionValues for a given store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Lists ProductOptionValues for a store and language that are not display-only.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its ID within a specific store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Finds ProductOptionValues by name within a store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its code within a store.
